notes: Real clothes. Shirts, shorts and pants are now actual garments that hang off the body instead of paint on the skin: they fit every build, have real hems, sleeves and necklines, and move like cloth (hems and sleeves swing with fast moves and settle back, fabric hangs when you raise a knee). Fight shorts look like real fight shorts. Shoulders blend into the chest and back properly and armpits aren't dark any more. Tattoos are ink in the skin with real designs (a full sleeve, chest wings, tribal). Better hair for every style. Dodge cooldown is shorter and you can chain dodges. Online: a perfect dodge no longer drops the other player into heavy slow motion (that's why online felt slowed down).
